inspiration.creator: Luke's Dev Lab
inspiration.adaptation: Category structure and side-by-side evidence presentation are inspirations; prompts, results, branding and score claims are not copied.

scope: Future optional capability and engineering tests; no retroactive E19 outcome or E20/E21/E22 confirmatory gate changes.

tests.title: Performance
tests.subtitle: Prefill, decode and measured resource cost
tests.measures: Cached and uncached prefill tokens/s, decode tokens/s, time-to-first-token, peak allocated and reserved VRAM.
tests.method: Pin exact model/tokenizer/config hashes, quantization, GPU, runtime and context length. Separate cold/warm and cache conditions; warm up, synchronize GPU, repeat fixed prompt/output lengths, report median and spread with per-trial receipts.
tests.grade: Descriptive per-hardware metrics, never a capability PASS. Compare only matched hardware, context, batch, precision and measurement boundaries.
tests.controls: Disclose startup/excluded time, OOM, CPU offload, KV cache, sampling, stop conditions and failed trials.

tests.title: Long-context retrieval
tests.subtitle: Find planted facts across context positions
tests.measures: Exact retrieval at 0%, 25%, 50%, 75% and 100% of a declared context length; answer and abstention rates.
tests.method: Generate rights-cleared controlled contexts and balanced decoys; preregister seeds, position bins, target length and total examples. Keep final items behind independent custody; randomize ordering and retain raw predictions.
tests.grade: Report n/N per position plus overall and confidence interval. Wrong, omitted and malformed answers remain distinct.
tests.controls: Audit string leakage, truncation, positional cues, prompt contamination and retrieval-by-guessing baselines.

tests.title: Reasoning
tests.subtitle: Four predeclared difficulty bands
tests.measures: Accuracy by easy, medium, hard and expert strata, answer rate and error type.
tests.method: Use original, rights-cleared questions with sealed final split and independently reviewed difficulty labels; pin the prompt and token budget before responses are seen.
tests.grade: Deterministic gold answers where possible; otherwise blinded rubric and adjudication. Report every denominator, not just aggregate accuracy.
tests.controls: Check label shortcuts, memorization and evaluator agreement; no post-outcome threshold changes.

tests.title: Python coding
tests.subtitle: HumanEval-style, not an unapproved HumanEval claim
tests.measures: pass@1, answer rate and pass rate among answered tasks.
tests.method: Use approved original tasks or separately licensed public tasks with contamination review. Generate once per task at fixed sampling and budget; execute in a network-disabled sandbox with time/memory limits and hidden tests.
tests.grade: Tests passing / all assigned; answered / all assigned; tests passing / answered. Include timeout and unsafe-output categories.
tests.controls: Pin interpreter/dependencies, sandbox image and evaluator hashes; independently verify a sample of grader decisions.

tests.title: Kanban app
tests.subtitle: Practical front-end implementation
tests.measures: Working card CRUD, status movement, labels/assignees, persistence and responsive usability.
tests.method: Give a fixed original specification and isolated repository; run a build, unit and browser interaction checks on the submitted artifact.
tests.grade: Deterministic functional checklist plus blinded screenshot/UI review; report working features and critical failures separately.
tests.controls: Record tool calls, runtime, dependency install and reproduction instructions; a screenshot alone is not a pass.

tests.title: Sand simulation
tests.subtitle: Algorithmic interactive system
tests.measures: Conservation and collision rules, deterministic replay, frame time and interaction correctness.
tests.method: Use an original sandboxed spec with seeded scenarios and property-based edge cases; execute the simulation in a real browser.
tests.grade: Automated invariants and scenario outcomes with a separate visual/usability check; show measured frame time rather than styling alone.
tests.controls: Reveal seeds only after submitted code is frozen; retain traces and browser console errors.

tests.title: Dungeon crawler
tests.subtitle: State, planning and pathfinding
tests.measures: Reachable levels, valid navigation, resource-state consistency, win/lose flow and determinism.
tests.method: Provide an original bounded game spec, fixed starter repo and seeded maps; drive real inputs through a complete round.
tests.grade: Automated invariant/acceptance gates plus blinded playability rubric; keep crashes and blocked completions visible.
tests.controls: Check scripted shortcuts, impossible maps, hidden-state access and restart paths.

tests.title: Blender scene
tests.subtitle: 3D artifact, not just code prose
tests.measures: Valid saved scene, object topology/material constraints, clean render and reproducible opening.
tests.method: Apply an original fixed asset brief with version-pinned Blender in a sandbox; reopen the .blend and render from clean state.
tests.grade: Machine checks for object/scene validity plus blinded artistic rubric; archive .blend, render and logs.
tests.controls: Declare external assets/rights and file-size limits; do not score an image if the scene fails to reopen.

tests.title: Godot scene
tests.subtitle: Moving-platform gameplay integration
tests.measures: Scene loads, movement/control, platform behavior, reachable objective and clean runtime.
tests.method: Use an original fixed project brief with pinned Godot version; open in headless test, then exercise a real playable session.
tests.grade: Executable scene and scripted interaction gates plus blinded gameplay/usability review; retain project, logs and capture.
tests.controls: No success inferred from generated code or screenshots alone; flag plugins and external assets.
